title: The rain-laden trees of the avenue evoked in him, as always, memories of the girls and women in the plays of Gerhart Hauptmann; and the memory of their pale sorrows and the fragrance falling from the wet branches mingled in a mood of quiet joy.
html_source:
Gearhart Hauptmann was a German playwright.

Stephen is trying to avert his focus from screeching nuns in asylums and heaps of trash and mud by turning his mind to more aesthetically pleasing or beautiful things.

Stephen shows how he handles embittering and unpleasant situations by thinking of what he finds more pleasant and perhaps more meaningful. He shows his preference to aesthetics to ascend from the unattractive muck around him. His inclination to aesthetics will become easily observable later in the chapter…
